subject: Annual CPA Public Hearing and Project Updates
overview: The Medford Community Preservation Committee held its annual public hearing to review Fiscal Year 2026 Community Preservation Act projects, public feedback, and department updates. The committee also received a presentation on the Mystic Shoreline Initiative and approved past meeting minutes.

items.title: Annual CPA Public Hearing and Presentation
items.summary: Theresa Dupont presented an overview of Community Preservation Act funding history and reviewed $2.4 million in awarded Fiscal Year 2026 projects across open space, historic preservation, and affordable housing.

items.title: Public Participation and Partner Updates
items.summary: The committee heard feedback and updates from residents and officials on accessibility, cemetery master planning, recreation facility upgrades, and affordable housing challenges.

items.title: Mystic Shoreline Initiative Presentation
items.summary: Carl Alexander of the Mystic River Watershed Association presented conceptual plans for shoreline restoration, accessible pathways, and recreational improvements along the Mystic River and Mystic Lakes.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and Committee Business
items.summary: The committee deferred officer elections to the next meeting and approved the meeting minutes for January and February 2026.
